question: For the first time in the world, the Five-Year Plan (1928–32), was implemented by ___________ in Soviet Union.
solution:
The correct answer is __Joseph Stalin__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e3594069eb4eac3d559af7c626aabe4ee4145967932cf8ad78e35476f134a4b8.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• Joseph Stalin was the Russian leader who first implemented the Five Year Plan approach in Russia__.

 __
 
• Joseph Stalin implemented the first FYP in the Soviet Union in the late 1920s.
 
• Most communist states and many capitalist countries later adopted them.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3e20068b61817b168623bbf4377a66602deb382bfb1e34ae29a5e35078dcefcb.png] Additional Information__

 
• After independence, India launched its first five-year plan in 1951.
 
• The first five-year plan was based on Harrod-Domar Model.
 
• The Eighth Plan could not take off in 1990 due to the fast-changing political situation at the Centre and the years 1990-91 and 1991-92 were treated as Annual Plans.
